title: Risk gate: memory search and self-work's worktree reads get the read tier (#1399)
body:
Fixes #1399.

`memory__search_facts` and `self_work__files` / `read` / `search` / `plan` / `review` only read her memory or her worktree. They weren't in `BUILTIN_TIERS`, so they fell to "write" and asked me first in smart mode. They now have the read tier.

Unchanged, still asking first: `analysis__run_python` (runs code), `mana_update__*` (changes her install), and `self_work__start` / `refresh` / `reply` (start or change runs that push PRs). `resources__status` gets its read tier in #1394.

This changes the approval gate, so it waits for my review before merging.

Test: one in `test/tool-risk.test.js`, run in CI.
interface: The merged change for PR #1401 is covered by test/tool-risk.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
